name: COMP_047
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (50%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Invasive (50%) nearly ties InSitu (47%) [F1], with tumor called at three simulated frozen-section margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 50%, InSitu 47%, Normal 2%, Benign 1% | Near tie: Invasive vs InSitu |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 96%, OOD 76th percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models pick same class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive [F5], 2/5 InSitu (BACH_0155 86%) | Split between Invasive and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.04 contribution) [F2]; 19/20 AI check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable score (-0.89 contribution) [F3]; 0/20 AI check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 11) · context · Below-typical score (+0.38 contribution) [F4]; 8/20 AI check · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.26 contribution); differs in BACH_0155 (12/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing three highest-risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- True class is InSitu (47% probability, in conformal set, matching 2/5 neighbors including BACH_0155 at 86% similarity).
- Simulated composite frozen-section edges distort margin calls (stains blocked), while counter-evidence uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20 check).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Highest risk (100%); verify stromal invasion versus duct confinement (region 9) at inferior/medial margins.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 11**: High risk (53%–88%); check lateral (323 um), medial (323 um), and inferior (860 um) margins.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 3**: Risk is 0%–1%, contradicting high invasion (0, 3) and unreliable normal-lobule (0, 2, 3) scores.
